audit_metadata.objective: Identify hardcoded, unvalidated, or circular gates and establish replacement logic.

source_identity.flaw: Relied on static summary without re-verifying full 1-to-1 split-to-corpus ID mapping and zero duplicate IDs.
source_identity.remediation: Evaluate directly against SPLIT_V2_MANIFEST.json and CORPUS_V2_CLEANED_MANIFEST.json.

raw_loss_aggregation.flaw: Used pre-calculated JSON audit without dynamic summation across 290 PER_DOCUMENT_LOSSES.jsonl records.
raw_loss_aggregation.remediation: Dynamically re-sum NLL across all lines in PER_DOCUMENT_LOSSES.jsonl.

baseline_vs_candidate_reproducibility.flaw: Trusted FRESH_EVALUATION.json metrics without validating against raw document records.
baseline_vs_candidate_reproducibility.remediation: Derive win rate and delta CE directly from document records.

sanskrit_coverage_and_regression.flaw: Inferred zero Sanskrit training coverage without resolving and tokenizing actual training texts.
sanskrit_coverage_and_regression.remediation: Resolved 782 train documents, canonical tokenizer execution, and raw NLL delta checks.

checkpoint_identity_and_artifact_integri.flaw: Relied on static initial_artifacts_hashes.json without dynamic hash verification at gate evaluation time.
checkpoint_identity_and_artifact_integri.remediation: Dynamically compute SHA-256 for all 6 core assets against immutable constants.

protected_file_provenance.flaw: Unconditionally marked VERIFIED based on filesystem mtime alone without noting that unstaged diff lacks immutable commit object.
protected_file_provenance.remediation: Report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED reflecting honest classification between historical documentation and uncommitted working copy status.

regression_tests.flaw: Pointed to tests/ directory and hardcoded 25/25 without parsing execution artifacts.
regression_tests.remediation: Parse real pytest execution logs REGRESSION_TEST_RESULTS.json and REGRESSION_TEST_RESULTS.txt.

gate_repair_rules_enforced: No hardcoded overall verdict or recommendation.
Derive overall verdict strictly from gate outcomes.
